summary: Enlivex Ltd., an Israeli-domiciled, Nasdaq-listed clinical-stage biopharmaceutical foreign private issuer, furnished a Form 6-K announcing an Extraordinary General Meeting (the non-US analogue of a special shareholder meeting) for October 14, 2026, at its Ness Ziona offices. The sole agenda item is approval of a 1-for-16 reverse share split of ordinary shares, effective as soon as practicable after shareholder approval, plus a conforming amendment to the Articles of Association. The Board recommends voting FOR. Record date is October 5, 2026. Watch post-split trading liquidity, Nasdaq minimum-bid compliance and any concurrent capital raise.
